reason: The Javadoc at services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionEvaluator.java:142-146 only promises "IDs of groups with view permission". GroupPermissionsV2.java:121-123 instead adds `groupResource.getId()` for resources of type "Groups", and only the all-groups type resource carries that type (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:271-276; per-group resources are created untyped at :121), so V2 returns that resource's ID, not group IDs.
